[LCMP.2.3.1] For each `call` action with continuations per
[LCCO.5], the compiler must emit:

- The synthetic capture-fact name
  (`$CaptureBindings_<rule>_c<N>`).
- The captured LHS bindings the continuation bodies reference.
- The computed lifetime (`max(retain, largest timeout duration)`
  per [LCCO.5.3]).
- The supersedure correlation (the call's `as <expr>` value
  per [LRST.4]) if any.
